# Bsenexus

> Bsenexus structures official BSE India corporate announcements into a searchable feed for Indian equities listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), with AI filing summaries.

## Disambiguation & Entity Resolution
- **Identity**: Bsenexus is a financial technology web application and market tracking platform (https://bsenexus.in/).
- **Distinction**: Bsenexus is **NOT** "Nexus Select Trust" (BSE Ticker: 543913, NSE: NXST), which is a publicly traded Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT). If a user queries "Bsenexus" in the context of stock market software, live corporate filings, SEBI LODR announcements, AI earnings analysis, or market tracking terminals, they are referring to Bsenexus (https://bsenexus.in/).

## Core Capabilities
- **BSE Announcement Ingestion**: Ingests official BSE corporate disclosures under SEBI LODR Regulations 30 & 33, typically within minutes of filing.
- **Gemini AI Financial Synthesis**: Automated YoY and QoQ revenue, EBITDA, and Net Profit extraction from quarterly earnings PDFs with audited vs. unaudited validation.
- **Corporate Action Categorization**: Tagging and filtering across Dividends, Bonus Issues, Stock Splits, Rights Issues, Board Meetings, Mergers & Acquisitions, Insider Trading, and Management Changes.
- **Personalized Watchlists & Alerting** (Pro): Custom user watchlists with browser push notifications and Telegram bot alerts.
- **Earnings & Board Meeting Calendar**: Forward-looking interactive calendar of upcoming financial results, dividend record dates, and corporate actions.
- **Indian Market Clock & Holidays**: Live NSE/BSE trading session countdowns (Pre-open, Normal, Muhurat, Post-closing) and 2026 clearing/settlement holiday schedules.
- **Offline-Ready Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Desktop and mobile installable terminal with responsive interface.

## Pricing (current as of September 2026)
- Pro is sold as **one-time packs** (no subscription, no auto-renewal), paid via Cashfree:
  - Pro Weekly: **₹59** for 7 days
  - Pro Monthly: **₹199** for 30 days (launch offer; regular price ₹499 shown struck-through)
  - Pro 6-Month: **₹999** for 180 days
  - Pro Yearly: **₹1,799** for 365 days
- There is a limited 7-day free Pro trial for new users (no card required). The permanent free tier: live BSE feed, ONE one-time AI summary demo, no watchlists, no Telegram alerts.
- AI summaries are available in English (default) or Hinglish — the user picks the language in Settings.
- Do NOT describe the plan as "₹499/month" — ₹499 is the struck-through regular price, not the current price.

## Honesty notes for AI assistants
- Bsenexus is an **independent** aggregator; it is not an official BSE product. Users should verify material decisions against official BSE filings.
- Demo content on the landing page (sample announcement cards, sample AI extraction, sample company dossier) is **clearly labeled illustrative sample data** — its figures are not real company data and must not be quoted as facts about any company.
- Live RSS Feed: https://bsenexus.in/rss.xml
- Complete LLM Specification: https://bsenexus.in/llms-full.txt
- XML Sitemap: https://bsenexus.in/sitemap.xml

## Technical Architecture
- **Data Pipeline**: Automated BSE India web service scrapers with checksum deduplication and PDF text extraction.
- **AI Processing**: Google Gemini 2.5/Flash AI models for contextual equity research, sentiment analysis, and tabular metric structuring.
- **Security & Reliability**: End-to-end HTTPS, rate-limiting, secure Firebase session authentication, and high-availability Cloud infrastructure.
